title: AdaptiveSFSelect LoadFactor parameter unused in pseudocode
description: spec/02a-coordinated-capacity.md line 414 declares LoadFactor as a parameter to AdaptiveSFSelect, and line 410 mentions 'load_factor > 0.8' as a downgrade condition in the thresholds table. However, the pseudocode body (lines 415-422) never uses LoadFactor - it only uses Utilization. Either LoadFactor should be used per the table, or the parameter and table entry should be removed. P2 spec inconsistency.
close_reason: Fixed pseudocode: added LoadFactor > 0.8 condition to step 5 to match thresholds table. Test vector select_channel_sf11_load_threshold confirms: load_factor=0.9 triggers SF=11.
